name: Image Alt Text Manager – Bulk & Dynamic Alt Tags For image SEO Optimization + AI
author: WPSAAD

sections.description:
The Image Alt Text Manager plugin automatically and dynamically bulk-changes WordPress images’ alt text and title attributes. It can also generate missing values on your:

[Free Version] Homepage, Pages, Posts, Blog
[Premium Version] Products, Shop page, Custom Post Types, and Archives

The AI Generation Feature (Premium) allows you to generate context-aware alt text using artificial intelligence powered by the ChatGPT API. It’s a complete solution for generating both alt and title attributes.

Why Image SEO Matters

Images SEO performance is essential for search engines like Google Images to bring traffic to your website.
Google uses alt text to associate images with keywords and link them to your website content.

That’s why Image Alt Text Manager comes with dynamic related alt and title tags — giving your website better performance in Google Images, Google Insights, and other search engines.

Works like a charm
“It’s perfect, this is what I needed. Now my site SEO score is really high. Thank you!”
— lbazso

Very useful plugin
“It does exactly what I was looking for.”
— xmartix

Plugin Features

  1. Bulk generate image alt tags from dynamic values related to posts, pages, products, or custom post types.
  2. Bulk generate image title tags (post, page, product, custom post type).
  3. Optionally generate only empty alt or title tags.
  4. AI-powered generation of context-aware alt text using the ChatGPT API (Premium).

Supported Dynamic Values

  • Site Name
  • Site Description
  • Page Title
  • Post Title
  • Product Title
  • Image Alt
  • Image Name
  • Image Caption
  • Image Description

Supported Types

Free Version: Homepage, Blog, Posts, Pages
Premium Version: Products, Shop Page, Custom Post Types, AI Generation Feature

Network (Multisite) Support

Image Alt Text Manager supports multisite environments with:
* Centralized Control — manage global settings from the Network Admin.
* Per-Site Customization — allow overrides per subsite.
* Bulk Operations — update thousands of images across the network at once.

Benefits

  • Improved accessibility and SEO rankings
  • AI-powered automatic alt generation
  • Front-end dynamic replacement (no media edits)
  • Safe and reversible — original media untouched
  • Compatible with WPML

Upgrade to Pro

Generate alt and title for product and custom post type images, optimize WooCommerce galleries, and use AI-powered generation.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the image-alt-text-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure and generate alt/title tags from Dashboard → Settings → Image Alt Text Manager.
sections.faq:
Why do I need this plugin?

It makes your website’s images SEO-friendly by adding descriptive alt and title attributes automatically.

How do I use Image Alt Text Manager?

Install, activate, then open Dashboard → Settings → Image Alt Text Manager and configure your preferred options.

It’s not working.

  • Ensure your alt/title settings are selected in the plugin options.
  • Check that you’re inspecting <img> elements, not CSS backgrounds.
  • Clear your cache plugin and browser cache.
